summary.text: Amanda LaBrie is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 148 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Penny Morales Shaw.
Her career experience includes working as an event coordinator.

paragraphs.text: Amanda LaBrie earned a high school diploma from Waltrip High School and a graduate degree from the University of Texas Permian Basin in 2011.
Her career experience includes working as an event coordinator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in House District 148, serves as a precinct chair and leads a neighborhood watch, and worked as an in-house landman for several oil and gas companies.
She won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 148 with no opposition.

She listed conservative Texas values, protecting girls' sports, and parental rights and education as her key campaign messages, and said she supports the oil and gas industry and Texas-owned businesses.
